{{Infobox auto|type=Material|renewable=No}}
'''Tallow''' is a material found in [[Igloo|igloo]] chests. It is a variant of [[Wax]] with its own name and texture, and can be used anywhere wax can.

== Obtaining ==
=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}
The igloo chest rolls 5 to 8 times from a pool in which tallow (1–2) has a weight of 15 out of 51.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/igloo_chest.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
Tallow is a honeycomb item underneath, like wax, so every recipe and interaction that takes wax also accepts tallow: waxing copper blocks, crafting candles, and the pack's recipes that use wax, such as the [[Elegy of Icarus]] and the Crete [[Music Disc|music disc]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/music_disc_crete.json}}</ref> See [[Wax#Usage]].

Tallow and wax do not stack with each other, because tallow carries a different name and model.
